Name: part_mass_circuit
Title: How a Particle Transformer Computes Jet Mass
Short Hypothesis: ParT computes jet mass through geometric routing: a pair-bias formula fixes head roles; head b2h8 switches near 85 GeV; far-side heads write into the W/Z neuron n98. Variables of higher algebraic depth appear in later blocks.
Related Work: Rai & Ganguly 2605.09881; Wang et al. 2412.03673; causal abstraction / interchange interventions (Geiger et al.).
Experiments: per-block readability of observables (E10 on ParT)
Risk Factors and Limitations: Overlap with Rai & Ganguly; single checkpoint per input set.
